signals.text: Maddison shines on return - Tottenham v Coventry ratings. How Spurs and Coventry City's players rated following their Premier League match.

Lampard 'proud' of Coventry performance in defeat by Spurs. Coventry City manager Frank Lampard says he is proud of his side's performance, despite losing at struggling Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League.

Moyes insider doubts potential Celtic move - gossip. Former striker Louis Saha, who played under David Moyes at Everton, doubts whether Celtic would be able to lure away the Premier League boss in their hunt to land a successor to Martin O'Neill.
